Ingress: backend → TCP/8443 ONLY
Egress: → egress-proxy TCP/443 ONLY
ALL OTHER: DENIED" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="250" x="290" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cots_ctrl" parent="ns_cots" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFE0B2;strokeColor=#C62828;fontSize=10;size=15;" value="4 Compensating Controls:
